newsitem.title: USA: TIAA-CREF Real Estate Account enters joint venture.
newsitem.headline: TIAA-CREF Real Estate Account enters joint venture.

text.p: Teachers Insurance and Annuity Association-College Retirement Equities Fund (TIAA-CREF) said on Wednesday that its TIAA Real Estate Account had entered into a joint venture with USF&G Corp to buy eight office properties.
TIAA Real Estate Account said it invested $149 million in the project and that USF&G Realty Advisors Inc will provide asset management services.
Under terms of the agreement, the TIAA Real Estate Account has a 90 percent interest in the joint venture, a newly formed Maryland-based partnership known as Light Street Partners LLP.
A subsidiary of USF&G owns the remaining 10 percent interest in the partnership, TIAA said in a statement.
The office properties purchased through the joint venture have an aggregate net leasable area of 1.3 million square feet, TIAA said, adding that over 90 percent of the space was leased.
The TIAA Real Estate Account is one of nine variable annuity accounts available in the TIAA-CREF pension system.
USF&G Corp provides property and casualty insurance and other financial services.
